evidence: Running the local repro shows root-level StepCounter outputs, but nested next/data step_count and truncated keys are absent even though the env exposes nested data/done keys. The run ends with AssertionError: StepCounter did not create a nested step_count key when a root done key was present.
steps: Create a TransformedEnv from NestedCountingEnv(has_root_done=True, nest_done=True, max_steps=2) with StepCounter(max_steps=2).
Run a short rollout and inspect the produced keys.
Verify that root next/done, next/truncated, and next/step_count exist while nested next/data/step_count and next/data/truncated do not.
The repro exits with an AssertionError once the missing nested step_count key is checked.
